title: Derived sum adjunction and normalized etale chart left comparison
statement: For a commutative ring $A$ of universe $u+1$ and a separated etale finite-type morphism $v:V\to T$ of schemes of universe $u$ [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-etale-morphism] [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], define the adjunction $Dv_{\Sigma!}\dashv v^*$ on the whole ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] by descending the exact sum-extension/inverse-image adjunction degreewise, with its sum/evaluation counit [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension] [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. If $A$ is finite, $V,T,S$ are Noetherian, $f:T\to S$, $c$ is a compactification of $f$ and $d$ one of $f\circ v$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], and $M$ is a graph-normalized compact-support comparison datum [def-sp-etale-compact-support-normalization], define the specified left comparison $Rf_!^c\circ Dv_{\Sigma!}\simeq R(f\circ v)_!^d$, using the compact-support candidates [def-amb-etale-compact-support], to be the composite of $M$'s inverse comparison for $v$ at the restricted closure compactification $d.\mathrm{ofComp}(c)$, the proper/open composition comparison at this compatible compactification, and the canonical common-refinement comparison from the compatible composite compactification $c.\mathrm{comp}(d.\mathrm{ofComp}(c))$ to $d$.

source.place: the derived sum-extension adjunction and its proof, composition/refinement left comparison, also published in EtaleAmbientAdjointLocality

lean.statement:
def etaleAmbientLeftComparison
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : EtaleCompactSupportNormalization A)
    {U X S : Scheme.{u}} (u : U ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Etale u] [IsSeparated u] [IsNoetherian U] [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian S]
    (c : Compactification f) (d : Compactification (u ≫ f)) :
    (etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) u inferInstance).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c ≅
      rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) d
lean.note: Owns only the already published constructed left comparison and degreewise sum adjunction, not the right-adjoint locality theorem. The currently used generic derived adjunction is in WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.Etale.LowerShriek.EtaleMapProjection and takes ModuleCat A, v and its etaleness proof; the locality module publicly exposes that owner.
